# Command Index

<!-- Generated by Build-Docs.ps1. Do not edit. Your changes will be overwritten. -->

## Windows

| Command | Synopsis |
|---------|----------|
| [Close-UiWindow](Close-UiWindow) | Closes the window your code is running in (or the window that opened it). |
| [New-UiChildWindow](New-UiChildWindow) | Creates a child window that automatically inherits the parent's theme. |
| [New-UiWindow](New-UiWindow) | Creates the main application window from a scriptblock of PsUi controls and waits until it's closed. |

## Layout

| Command | Synopsis |
|---------|----------|
| [New-UiCard](New-UiCard) | Creates a bordered card container with optional header. |
| [New-UiGrid](New-UiGrid) | Creates a Grid layout container with simplified column/row management. |
| [New-UiHeaderAction](New-UiHeaderAction) | Defines the header button for New-UiPanel -HeaderAction. |
| [New-UiPanel](New-UiPanel) | Creates a panel container for organizing child controls. |
| [New-UiSpacer](New-UiSpacer) | Creates a transparent spacer that fills remaining space in the current parent. |
| [New-UiTab](New-UiTab) | Creates a tab with an optional header icon. Content scrolls if it overflows. |

## Buttons and Actions

| Command | Synopsis |
|---------|----------|
| [New-UiAction](New-UiAction) | Creates a silent button that runs actions without an output window. |
| [New-UiActionCard](New-UiActionCard) | Creates a silent action card that runs without an output window. |
| [New-UiButton](New-UiButton) | Creates a styled button with async action support. |
| [New-UiButtonCard](New-UiButtonCard) | Creates a button card with icon, header, description, and an action button. |
| [New-UiDropdownButton](New-UiDropdownButton) | Creates a compact popup button with selectable items. |
| [New-UiResultAction](New-UiResultAction) | Defines one entry for a button's Actions dropdown in the output window. |
| [Register-UiHotkey](Register-UiHotkey) | Registers a keyboard shortcut to trigger an action. |

| Command | Synopsis |
|---------|----------|
| [Get-UiValue](Get-UiValue) | Gets the value of a UI control by its variable name. |

| [New-UiDatePicker](New-UiDatePicker) | Creates a date picker control. |
| [New-UiDropdown](New-UiDropdown) | Creates a dropdown selection control. |
| [New-UiInput](New-UiInput) | Creates a labeled text input field. |

| [New-UiSlider](New-UiSlider) | Creates a slider control for numeric value selection. |
| [New-UiTextArea](New-UiTextArea) | Creates a multi-line text input control. |
| [New-UiTimePicker](New-UiTimePicker) | Creates a time picker control for selecting hours and minutes. |
| [New-UiToggle](New-UiToggle) | Creates a checkbox/toggle control. |
| [Set-UiValue](Set-UiValue) | Sets the value of a UI control by its variable name. |

| Command | Synopsis |
|---------|----------|
| [New-UiChart](New-UiChart) | Creates a bar, line, or pie chart that stretches to fill its parent. |
| [Update-UiChart](Update-UiChart) | Updates an existing chart with new data. |

## Status and Progress

| Command | Synopsis |
|---------|----------|
| [Clear-UiStatus](Clear-UiStatus) | Resets a status bar to its initial state. |
| [Hide-UiStatusBar](Hide-UiStatusBar) | Collapses a status bar from view without removing it. |
| [New-UiProgress](New-UiProgress) | Creates a progress bar. |
| [New-UiStatusBar](New-UiStatusBar) | Creates a status bar docked to the bottom (or top) of the window. |
| [Set-UiProgress](Set-UiProgress) | Updates a progress bar's value, label, severity tint, or mode. |
| [Set-UiStatusBar](Set-UiStatusBar) | Updates status bar text, progress, and severity from any thread. |
| [Show-UiStatusBar](Show-UiStatusBar) | Restores a previously hidden status bar to view. |
| [Write-Status](Write-Status) | Writes a status message to a PsUi status bar from any thread. |

| Command | Synopsis |
|---------|----------|
| [Add-UiDataGridItem](Add-UiDataGridItem) | Appends a row to a New-UiDataGrid. |
| [Add-UiListItem](Add-UiListItem) | Adds an item to a list or dropdown. |
| [Clear-UiDataGridItems](Clear-UiDataGridItems) | Empties a New-UiDataGrid. |
| [Clear-UiList](Clear-UiList) | Clears all items from a list or dropdown. |
| [Get-UiListItems](Get-UiListItems) | Gets all items from a list or dropdown. |
| [New-UiColumn](New-UiColumn) | Defines one column for New-UiDataGrid -Columns. |
| [New-UiDataGrid](New-UiDataGrid) | Themed datagrid. Drops inside a New-UiWindow next to other controls. |
| [New-UiList](New-UiList) | Themed listbox. Optional filter box and select-all/none buttons. |
| [New-UiMenuItem](New-UiMenuItem) | Defines one entry for a data grid's right-click menu. |
| [New-UiTree](New-UiTree) | Creates a hierarchical tree view for displaying nested data. |
| [Remove-UiListItem](Remove-UiListItem) | Removes an item from a list or dropdown. |
| [Set-UiDataGridItems](Set-UiDataGridItems) | Replaces every row in a New-UiDataGrid. |

## Session, Theming, Icons, and Async

| Command | Synopsis |
|---------|----------|
| [Get-PsUiIcon](Get-PsUiIcon) | Gets an icon glyph by name. |
| [Get-PsUiIconFont](Get-PsUiIconFont) | Returns the currently active icon font name. |
| [Get-PsUiIconList](Get-PsUiIconList) | Lists all available icon names. |
| [Get-UiSession](Get-UiSession) | The live session object for the window your code is running in. |
| [Get-UiThemeTemplate](Get-UiThemeTemplate) | Returns a template hashtable showing all available theme color keys. |
| [Invoke-UiAsync](Invoke-UiAsync) | Runs a scriptblock in the background without freezing the UI. |
| [Register-UiTheme](Register-UiTheme) | Registers a custom theme for use in PsUi windows. |
| [Reset-UiSession](Reset-UiSession) | Resets the PsUi module state after a crash or error. |
| [Set-PsUiIconFont](Set-PsUiIconFont) | Sets the icon font used by PsUi controls. |
| [Set-UiCapturedVariable](Set-UiCapturedVariable) | Stores a value that later actions in the window receive as a variable. |
| [Stop-UiAsync](Stop-UiAsync) | Cancels the currently running async operation. |
| [Test-PsUiIcon](Test-PsUiIcon) | Tests whether an icon name will render under the current (or a specified) icon font. |
